name: Adaptive Subdivision for Unsteady Flows
definition: A subdivision scheme for unsteady flows that handles both cross-sectional (spatial) and temporal (time-direction) adaptation. Unlike static flows, subdivision can be required anywhere in the volume, not just at the front, and must support deletion of vertices.
summary: Adaptive Subdivision for Unsteady Flows renders flow volumes by adapting tetrahedral meshes in both space and time, prioritizing real-time performance over absolute accuracy.
